title: Patch: standardize card text: one wording per effect and the terms players can hover
notes: Issue #3941: a wording pass over every English face, held to R3941000's sweep (crates/cards/tests/cross/card_text.rs). A term prints as its glossary label so it bolds and shows its rule (R910000): Phase Weaver's "end of its owner's turn" is End of turn, Impact Reactor's "When awoken" is When this awakens, Shawarma Law's "Can't defend" is Can't Defend, Phase Fabric's "Can't be Attacked" is Can't be attacked, Mindustrial Cross-over's "Starpiece" is Starship Piece. One wording per clause: a lasting turn effect is "For the rest of the game." over a Start of turn line (Jlockeed's Forever War, Mindustrial Revolution, as Jlockeed's Permanent Defense Contract), a cost set on an added card is its own sentence, a hand or deck trigger opens "While this is in your …", "Dealing damage Burns" is "Damage also Burns", and a stat gained is +N Attack or +N Health. Broken text is fixed: Graphite's pasted reminder, Scorch's "attack 10 attacks", Astrophage's and Colony Watcher's Evolve lines, Meltdown's "When this attack", Vela's and Corvus's Activates, PIP's and The Enigmata's numbers, Great Paperclip Theory II's "Choose one α or β;.", Spaceberry's missing noun. Wording only: no card plays differently. C+ #37 Wardrum's and M #87 Tatches the Totem's new wording rides with the Stinkyscape Balance Changes V fragment, which claims them already.

player.title: Clearer card text
text: Keywords and triggers print as their glossary terms everywhere, so they bold and show their rule on hover: Phase Weaver's End of turn, Impact Reactor's When this awakens, Shawarma Law's Can't Defend, Phase Fabric's Can't be attacked and Mindustrial Cross-over's Starship Piece.
Jlockeed's Forever War and Mindustrial Revolution read "For the rest of the game." with a Start of turn line, as Jlockeed's Permanent Defense Contract does.
A cost an effect sets on the card it adds is a sentence of its own: "It costs (0)."
Wardrum, Tatches the Totem and Dogpile open their hand and deck triggers with "While this is in your …".
Every Weapon that burns says "Damage also Burns N".
Graphite, Scorch, Astrophage, Colony Watcher, Meltdown, Fuse, Vela, Corvus, PIP, The Enigmata, Great Paperclip Theory II and Spaceberry say what they do in plain, whole sentences.
Churnwalker, Arc, Shawarma Law and the drills read shorter, and Arc now fits its card without being cut.
